# 1 isrg-subscriber-server-certificate

Domain Validated TLS server certificates issued by ISRG (Let's Encrypt) Subordinate CAs under the ISRG CP/CPS

Profile `isrg-subscriber-server-certificate`, version 0.1.0.

| Field | Value | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `v3` | 7.1.1 |
| `serialNumber` | Greater than 0. More than 100 bits of output from a CSPRNG, optionally with additional non-random bits. | 7.1 |
| `signature` | One of: `sha256WithRSAEncryption`, `sha384WithRSAEncryption`, `sha512WithRSAEncryption`, `rsassaPssSha256`, `rsassaPssSha384`, `rsassaPssSha512`, `ecdsaWithSha384` | 7.1.3.2 |
| `issuer` | See [§1.1](#1.1) |  |
| `validity` | Validity period is less than 8640000 seconds (100 days) | 7.1 |
| `subject` | See [§1.2](#1.2) |  |
| `subjectPublicKeyInfo` | Algorithm: One of: `rsaEncryption`, `ecPublicKeyP256`, `ecPublicKeyP384`, `ecPublicKeyP521`. RSA modulus length is one of: 2048 bits; 3072 bits; 4096 bits. RSA public exponent is 65537 | 7.1.3.1 |
| `extensions` | See [§1.3](#1.3) |  |
| `signatureAlgorithm` | Identical to `signature` |  |
| `signatureValue` | A signature appropriate to the signatureAlgorithm field. |  |

`issuerUniqueID` and `subjectUniqueID` are absent.

<a id="1.1"></a>
## 1.1 Issuer Name

Byte-for-byte identical to the subject field of the Issuing CA.

Attributes appear in the order listed. DER encoding is one of: `issuerDnE5`; `issuerDnE6`; `issuerDnE7`; `issuerDnE8`; `issuerDnE9`; `issuerDnR10`; `issuerDnR11`; `issuerDnR12`; `issuerDnR13`; `issuerDnR14`; `issuerDnYE1`; `issuerDnYE2`; `issuerDnYE3`; `issuerDnYR1`; `issuerDnYR2`; `issuerDnYR3`.

| Attribute | Presence | Encoding | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `countryName` | Always | — | `US` |
| `organizationName` | Always | — | `Let's Encrypt` |
| `commonName` | Always | — | Matches `/^(E[5-9]\|R1[0-4]\|Y[ER][1-3])$/` |

No other attributes are present.

<a id="1.2"></a>
## 1.2 Subject Name

CN omitted, or optionally contains one of the values from the Subject Alternative Name extension. No other attributes are included (Section 7.1.4).

At most 1 RDN.

| Attribute | Presence | Encoding | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commonName` | Optional | — | Matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9*._:-]{1,64}$/` |

No other attributes are present.

<a id="1.3"></a>
## 1.3 Extensions

| Extension | Presence | Critical | Value | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authorityInformationAccess` | Always | No | See [§1.3.1](#1.3.1) | 7.1 |
| `authorityKeyIdentifier` | Always | No | `keyIdentifier` is one of: `skidE5`; `skidE6`; `skidE7`; `skidE8`; `skidE9`; `skidR10`; `skidR11`; `skidR12`; `skidR13`; `skidR14`; `skidYE1`; `skidYE2`; `skidYE3`; `skidYR1`; `skidYR2`; `skidYR3`. Contains a keyIdentifier byte-for-byte identical to the subjectKeyIdentifier of the Issuing CA. | 7.1 |
| `basicConstraints` | Always | Yes | `cA` is `FALSE` | 7.1 |
| `certificatePolicies` | Always | No | See [§1.3.2](#1.3.2) | 7.1 |
| `crlDistributionPoints` | Always | No | See [§1.3.3](#1.3.3) | 7.1 |
| `extendedKeyUsage` | Always | No | See [§1.3.4](#1.3.4) | 7.1 |
| `keyUsage` | Always | Yes | Bits set: `digitalSignature`. Bits optionally set: `keyEncipherment`. No other bits are set. keyEncipherment is only set for RSA keys. | 7.1 |
| `sctList` | Always | No | Contains at least two SCTs from logs run by different operators. | 7.1 |
| `subjectAltName` | Always | — | Each name is one of: `dNSName`; `iPAddress`. Between 1 and 100 names. Critical if the subject commonName is omitted. | 7.1 |
| `subjectKeyIdentifier` | Optional | No | Encoded value matches `/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/`. Optionally contains a truncated hash of the subjectPublicKey, per Section 2(1) of RFC 7093. | 7.1 |

No other extensions are present.

<a id="1.3.1"></a>
### 1.3.1 Authority Information Access

Contains the HTTP URI of the Issuing CA's Certificate.

| Access Method | Presence | Access Location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CA Issuers (`id-ad-caIssuers`) | Always | `uniformResourceIdentifier` matches `/^http://(e[5-9]\|r1[0-4]\|y[er][1-3])\.i\.lencr\.org/$/` |

No other access descriptions are present.

<a id="1.3.2"></a>
### 1.3.2 Certificate Policies

| Policy Identifier | Presence | Qualifiers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cabfDomainValidated` | Always | None |

No other policies are present.

<a id="1.3.3"></a>
### 1.3.3 CRL Distribution Points

Contains the HTTP URI of a CRL issued by the Issuing CA whose scope includes this certificate.

| Distribution Point | Presence | Distribution Point Name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Always | `uniformResourceIdentifier` matches `/^http://(e[5-9]\|r1[0-4]\|y[er][1-3])\.c\.lencr\.org/[0-9]+\.crl$/` |

`reasons` and `cRLIssuer` are absent. No other distribution points are present.

<a id="1.3.4"></a>
### 1.3.4 Extended Key Usage

| Key Purpose | Presence |
| --- | --- |
| `idKpServerAuth` | Always |

No other key purposes are present.
